source_fidelity_reason: The source rows were already deleted from PG before this audit (chunk aged out under the old automatic 35-day retention), and this day was exported before per-row fingerprinting existed, so no source/file fingerprint was ever recorded. A matching Parquet SHA (recorded in the manifest) and a successful read prove the archived Parquet is an intact, readable cold copy consistent with its manifest, but they do NOT prove the file faithfully captured the now-deleted source.
research_use: NOT admissible as formal research evidence. Provenance is unverifiable_legacy (see docs/runbooks/cold-bar-gated-deletion-design-v1.md).
